lines.zh: 下界的火，把我烤得发亮。
lines.en: Nether fire has baked me bright.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙峡谷是我的家园！
lines.en: Soul Sand Valley is my home!

lines.zh: 下界的小鬼，走路带火星。
lines.en: A nether imp, leaving sparks as I walk.

lines.zh: 我在灵魂沙上留下脚印。
lines.en: I leave prints in the soul sand.
I leap out of the flames.

lines.zh: 下界荒地这么空，你的脚步很响。
lines.en: The wastes are empty; your steps ring loud.

lines.zh: 火光让我看清了你，别躲。
lines.en: The firelight lets me see you; don't hide.
Nether fire lights me while I grind my teeth.

lines.zh: 你的末日，从这声笑开始。
lines.en: Your end starts with this laugh.

lines.zh: 第二阶段的火，刚从脚下冒。
lines.en: Stage two fire just came up under my feet.

lines.zh: 我的爪子已经举起来了！
身体受伤，小妖精痛苦地哭泣。
lines.en: Injured, the gremlin cries out in pain.

lines.zh: 受伤了，小妖精发出哀号。
受伤了，小妖精痛苦呻吟。
lines.en: Injured, the gremlin groans in pain.

lines.zh: 受了伤，小妖精痛苦地叫喊。
lines.en: Injured, the gremlin cries out in pain.

lines.zh: 小妖精痛苦地哀叫，受伤了。
lines.en: The gremlin wails in pain, injured.

lines.zh: 受伤了，小妖精痛苦地哀叫。
lines.en: Injured, the gremlin wails in pain.

lines.zh: 被你勾引，就让你见识下我的利爪！
看我的魔法把你的肉身撕裂！
lines.en: Feel the magic tear your flesh!

lines.zh: 你敢靠近，我就把你吞噬！
lines.en: Come any closer and I’ll devour you!

lines.zh: 我的毒牙，让你痛苦不堪！
拿了我的东西，就得留下手！
lines.en: Take from me and leave a hand behind!

lines.zh: 你的生命就是我的燃料！

lines.en: Taste the fire in my palm!
Get out of my way, or die!
Collide with me and you’ll regret it!

lines.zh: 你的身体无法承受我的力量！
lines.en: Your body can’t handle my power!
The harder you hit, the faster you’ll die!

lines.zh: 躲开我，否则你会粉身碎骨！

lines.en: Testing my strength with your body?

lines.zh: 我的力量让你粉身碎骨！
你碰了我，就做好自尽的准备吧！
lines.en: Touching me means preparing to die!
Dare to touch me, and you’ll die!

lines.zh: 来吧，让我们繁殖下一代！
lines.en: Come, let’s reproduce the next generation!

lines.zh: 与我交配，体验我的力量！
lines.en: Mate with me, feel my power!

lines.zh: 与我结合，你将成为恶魔！
lines.en: Mate with me, and you’ll be a demon!

lines.zh: 让我们在灵魂沙中交配！
lines.en: Let’s mate in the soul sand!
Mate with me, and you’ll be stronger!
You belong with us, come on!
The Nether's heat warms the nest nicely.
Mate with me, and you’ll live forever!

lines.zh: 让我们在绯红森林中交配！
lines.en: Let’s mate in the Crimson Forest!

lines.zh: 闪烁着诡异光芒的球体缓缓落下
突然发出一声刺耳尖叫
lines.en: A sharp scream pierces the air

lines.zh: 幽绿色的火焰在它周围燃烧
锁定目标，准备跳跃攻击
lines.en: Locking onto target, preparing to leap

lines.zh: 感应到你的气息，立即行动

lines.en: Staring at you, seeking an opening

lines.zh: 察觉到你的存在，准备出手

lines.en: Aiming for you, one hit will kill

lines.zh: 锁定目标，准备发起突袭
追踪你的动作，等待时机
锁定你，准备发起致命一击
lines.en: Locked you, ready for final strike

lines.zh: 我闻到下界荒地来了活人。
lines.en: I smell a living one in the wastes.

lines.zh: 我把你划进了猎物一栏。

lines.en: I laugh once, high and thin.
I circle the fire half a turn.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地面刮三下。
lines.en: My claw scrapes the ground three times.
I wait for you to cross the crack.

lines.zh: 我把手里的东西捏碎了。
lines.en: I crush what is in my hand.

lines.zh: 我进入第二阶段，手更黑。
lines.en: Second stage now, and my hands are darker.

lines.zh: 我把火星撒进你的护甲！
lines.en: I scatter sparks into your armor!
I bite your calf from the side!

lines.zh: 我甩出一簇火星到你脸上！
lines.en: I fling a spray of sparks into your face!
I butt my head into your knee!
Evil spirit of the Blighted Forest!
Evil spirit of the Nether Wastes!
Guardian of the Soul Sand Canyons!

lines.zh: 燃烧的魔焰从我眼中射出！
灵魂火苗在我手中汇聚！
lines.en: Soul flames gather in my hand!
Evil spirit from the depths of the Blighted Forest!
My shrill laugh comes from the fire pit.
I crawl out of a lava crack.

lines.zh: 被火焰烧伤，小妖精惨叫。
lines.en: Burned by fire, the gremlin screams.
Injured from falling, the gremlin screams.
Injured from drowning, the gremlin screams.

lines.zh: 被爆炸炸伤，小妖精惨叫。
lines.en: Injured by explosion, the gremlin screams.

lines.zh: 被投射物击中，小妖精惨叫。
lines.en: Injured by projectile, the gremlin screams.

lines.zh: 被魔法攻击，小妖精惨叫。
lines.en: Injured by magic, the gremlin screams.

lines.zh: 饥饿过度，小妖精虚弱地哀叫。
被闪电击中，小妖精惨叫。
lines.en: Struck by lightning, the gremlin screams.
Falling into the void, the gremlin screams.
